ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider helpdesk-driven credential/MFA reset → fast risky sign-in → RMM agent install
ucs.description: Hunts the signature 0ktapus/UNC3944 chain: social-engineered helpdesk resets a user's password or MFA factor, the actor signs in (often from a residential proxy / unusual geo) within minutes, then drops a legitimate RMM agent (ScreenConnect, AnyDesk, Splashtop, Atera, RustDesk, Pulseway, Tailscale, Ngrok, Level) as their hands-on-keyboard channel before BlackCat/ALPHV or RansomHub deployment.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstSignIn max(_time) as lastSignIn from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action="success" Authentication.app IN ("AzureActiveDirectory","Okta","AzureAD") by Authentication.user Authentication.src Authentication.dest _time span=2m
| rename Authentication.user as user Authentication.src as src
| eval signinTime=_time
| join type=inner user [
    | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where All_Changes.action IN ("reset_password","password_reset","mfa_factor_reset","reset_factor","update_password") by All_Changes.user All_Changes.action _time span=2m
    | rename All_Changes.user as user All_Changes.action as resetAction
    | eval resetTime=_time ]
| where signinTime>=resetTime AND signinTime<=resetTime+3600
| join type=inner user [
    | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","AnyDesk.exe","SRService.exe","strwinclt.exe","Splashtop-streamer.exe","AteraAgent.exe","RustDesk.exe","PulsewayAgent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tailscaled.exe","ngrok.exe","level.exe","fleetdeck-agent.exe") by Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process _time span=1m
    | rename Processes.user as user Processes.dest as dest Processes.process_name as rmmBin Processes.process as rmmCmd
    | eval rmmTime=_time ]
| where rmmTime>=signinTime AND rmmTime<=signinTime+14400
| eval mins_reset_to_signin=round((signinTime-resetTime)/60,1), mins_signin_to_rmm=round((rmmTime-signinTime)/60,1)
| table resetTime signinTime rmmTime mins_reset_to_signin mins_signin_to_rmm user src dest resetAction rmmBin rmmCmd
| sort - rmmTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ChainWindow = 4h;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic([
    "screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "anydesk.exe","strwinclt.exe","splashtop-streamer.exe",
    "ateraagent.exe","atera_agent.exe","rustdesk.exe",
    "pulsewayagent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tailscaled.exe",
    "ngrok.exe","fleetdeck-agent.exe","level.exe","levelrmm.exe"]);
let RmmKeywords = dynamic([
    "screenconnect","anydesk","splashtop","ateraagent","rustdesk",
    "pulseway","tacticalrmm","tailscale","ngrok","fleetdeck","levelrmm"]);
let Resets = IdentityDirectoryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType has_any ("Password reset","Account password change","User Password Reset","MFA factor reset","Reset password")
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, TargetAccountUpn, ResetActor = AccountUpn, ResetAction = ActionType;
let RiskySignIns = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ("high","medium")
        or IsAnonymousProxy == true
        or Country !in~ ("US","CA","GB")  // tune to corp footprint
    | project SignInTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, City, Application, UserAgent;
let RmmExecs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName has_any (RmmBinaries)
         or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmKeywords)
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmKeywords)
    | project RmmTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RmmAccount = AccountUpn,
              RmmBinary = FileName, RmmCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              RmmParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RmmParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
Resets
| join kind=inner RiskySignIns on $left.TargetAccountUpn == $right.AccountUpn
| where SignInTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + ChainWindow)
| join kind=inner RmmExecs on $left.AccountUpn == $right.RmmAccount
| where RmmTime between (SignInTime .. SignInTime + ChainWindow)
| extend MinResetToSignIn = datetime_diff('minute', SignInTime, ResetTime),
         MinSignInToRmm   = datetime_diff('minute', RmmTime, SignInTime)
| project ResetTime, SignInTime, RmmTime, MinResetToSignIn, MinSignInToRmm,
          AccountUpn, ResetActor, ResetAction, IPAddress, Country, City, UserAgent,
          DeviceName, RmmBinary, RmmCmd, RmmParent
| order by RmmTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ChainWindow = 4h;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic([
    "ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe",
    "AnyDesk.exe","strwinclt.exe","Splashtop-streamer.exe",
    "AteraAgent.exe","Atera_Agent.exe","RustDesk.exe",
    "PulsewayAgent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tailscaled.exe",
    "ngrok.exe","fleetdeck-agent.exe","level.exe","LevelRMM.exe"]);
let RmmKeywords = dynamic([
    "screenconnect","anydesk","splashtop","ateraagent","rustdesk",
    "pulseway","tacticalrmm","tailscale","ngrok","fleetdeck","levelrmm"]);
let Resets = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where OperationName in~ ("Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password","Change user password","User registered all required security info","Admin reset MFA","Reset strong authentication method")
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName)
    | extend ActorUpn  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ActorUpn, ResetAction = OperationName;
let RiskySignIns = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ("high","medium")
         or tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion) !in~ ("US","CA","GB")
    | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress,
              Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion),
              City = tostring(LocationDetails.city),
              AppDisplayName, UserAgent;
let RmmExecs = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
    | where BinName in~ (RmmBinaries) or CommandLine has_any (RmmKeywords)
    | project RmmTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              RmmUpn = strcat(SubjectUserName, "@", SubjectDomainName),
              SubjectUserName, RmmBinary = NewProcessName, RmmCmd = CommandLine,
              RmmParent = ParentProcessName;
Resets
| join kind=inner RiskySignIns on $left.TargetUpn == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where SignInTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + ChainWindow)
| join kind=inner RmmExecs on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.RmmUpn
| where RmmTime between (SignInTime .. SignInTime + ChainWindow)
| extend MinResetToSignIn = datetime_diff('minute', SignInTime, ResetTime),
         MinSignInToRmm   = datetime_diff('minute', RmmTime, SignInTime)
| project ResetTime, SignInTime, RmmTime, MinResetToSignIn, MinSignInToRmm,
          UserPrincipalName, ActorUpn, ResetAction, IPAddress, Country, City,
          UserAgent, Computer, RmmBinary, RmmCmd, RmmParent
| order by RmmTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider BYOVD: POORTRY/STONESTOP-class driver drop + EDR service tamper
ucs.description: Detects the actor's signature anti-defense move: dropping a vulnerable (or attestation-signed-but-malicious) kernel driver to a user-writable path and then issuing service-control commands against EDR/Defender — the same POORTRY/STONESTOP toolkit Mandiant and Microsoft tied to UNC3944 prior to BlackCat/ALPHV and RansomHub encryption.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as dropTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("rentdrv2.sys","mhyprot2.sys","gdrv.sys","DBUtil_2_3.sys","asrdrv101.sys","asrdrv102.sys","procexp152.sys","iqvw64e.sys","stonestop.sys","poortry.sys","viragt64.sys","ngiodriver.sys")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user _time span=1m
| rename Filesystem.* as *
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as tamperTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process IN ("*sc stop*","*sc.exe stop*","*net stop*","*Stop-Service*","*Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring*","*Set-MpPreference -DisableBehaviorMonitoring*","*fltmc unload*")) AND (Processes.process IN ("*WinDefend*","*Sense*","*MsMpEng*","*CSFalcon*","*CrowdStrike*","*SentinelAgent*","*Carbon*","*Cylance*","*Sophos*","*Tanium*","*Cybereason*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name _time span=1m
    | rename Processes.* as * ]
| where tamperTime>=dropTime AND tamperTime<=dropTime+1800
| eval mins_drop_to_tamper=round((tamperTime-dropTime)/60,1)
| table dropTime tamperTime mins_drop_to_tamper dest user file_name file_path process_name process
| sort - dropTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ChainWindow = 30m;
let KnownBYOVD = dynamic([
    "rentdrv2.sys","mhyprot2.sys","gdrv.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys",
    "asrdrv101.sys","asrdrv102.sys","procexp152.sys",
    "iqvw64e.sys","viragt64.sys","ngiodriver.sys",
    "stonestop.sys","poortry.sys","truesight.sys","echodrv.sys"]);
let EdrTargets = dynamic([
    "windefend","sense","msmpeng","csfalconservice","csfalcon","crowdstrike",
    "sentinelagent","sentinelone","carbonblack","cylancesvc","sophos",
    "taniumclient","cybereason"]);
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
        and InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where FileName in~ (KnownBYOVD)
        or (FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\")
            and FolderPath !has @"\WindowsApps\"
            and FolderPath !has @"\DriverStore\")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DroppedDriver = FileName, DriverPath = FolderPath, DriverSHA256 = SHA256,
              DropProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let EdrTamper = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sc stop","sc.exe stop","net stop",
                                       "Stop-Service",
                                       "Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring",
                                       "Set-MpPreference -DisableBehaviorMonitoring",
                                       "fltmc unload")
    | extend CmdLower = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
    | where CmdLower has_any (EdrTargets)
    | project TamperTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              TamperBinary = FileName, TamperCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              TamperParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              TamperAccount = AccountName;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner EdrTamper on DeviceId
| where TamperTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + ChainWindow)
| extend MinsDropToTamper = datetime_diff('minute', TamperTime, DropTime)
| project DropTime, TamperTime, MinsDropToTamper, DeviceName,
          DroppedDriver, DriverPath, DriverSHA256,
          DropProcess, DropCmd, DropAccount,
          TamperBinary, TamperCmd, TamperAccount
| order by DropTime desc

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BYOVD Driver Drop to User-Writable Location (Scattered Spider / UNC3944 / Octo Tempest)
id: 9a1e5c44-2f8b-4d63-8f3a-b1c9f7e23bd5
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects creation of a Windows kernel driver (.sys) in a user-writable directory, or drop of a known
  vulnerable / abused driver by name. This is the hallmark of Scattered Spider / UNC3944 / Octo Tempest's
  POORTRY/STONESTOP kit, used to terminate EDR (Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) before BlackCat/ALPHV
  or RansomHub deployment.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/hunting-attestation-signed-malware
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1014
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1562.001
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  ext_sys:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.sys'
  user_writable:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
  known_byovd:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\rentdrv2.sys'
      - '\mhyprot2.sys'
      - '\gdrv.sys'
      - '\DBUtil_2_3.sys'
      - '\asrdrv101.sys'
      - '\asrdrv102.sys'
      - '\procexp152.sys'
      - '\iqvw64e.sys'
      - '\stonestop.sys'
      - '\poortry.sys'
      - '\truesight.sys'
      - '\echodrv.sys'
  filter_trusted:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
      - '\MsMpEng.exe'
      - '\WindowsUpdate.exe'
  condition: (known_byovd or (ext_sys and user_writable)) and not filter_trusted
falsepositives:
  - Driver developers building kernel modules in user-profile directories
  - Unusual signed RMM/EDR vendors shipping kernel components from non-standard paths (verify signer)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\rentdrv2.sys OR *\\mhyprot2.sys OR *\\gdrv.sys OR *\\DBUtil_2_3.sys OR *\\dbutil_2_3.sys OR *\\asrdrv101.sys OR *\\asrdrv102.sys OR *\\procexp152.sys OR *\\iqvw64e.sys OR *\\stonestop.sys OR *\\STONESTOP.sys OR *\\poortry.sys OR *\\POORTRY.sys OR *\\truesight.sys OR *\\echodrv.sys) OR (@TargetFilename:(*.sys OR *.SYS) AND @TargetFilename:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\users\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\*))) -@Image:(*\\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\\drvinst.exe OR *\\MsMpEng.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\.sys$/i
| TargetFileName=/(rentdrv2|mhyprot2|gdrv|dbutil_2_3|asrdrv10[12]|procexp152|iqvw64e|stonestop|poortry|truesight|echodrv)\.sys$/i OR regex("\\\\(Users|ProgramData|PerfLogs|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|Windows\\\\Temp)\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| NOT regex("\\\\(System32\\\\DriverStore|WinSxS|Microsoft\\\\WindowsApps)\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/(TrustedInstaller|drvinst|MsMpEng|WindowsUpdate)\.exe$/i
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
    | CommandLine=/(sc(\.exe)?\s+stop|net\s+stop|Stop-Service|Set-MpPreference\s+-Disable(Realtime|Behavior)Monitoring|fltmc\s+unload)/i
    | CommandLine=/(WinDefend|Sense|MsMpEng|CSFalcon(Service)?|CrowdStrike|SentinelAgent|SentinelOne|CarbonBlack|CylanceSvc|Sophos|TaniumClient|Cybereason)/i
  }, field=aid, include=[ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count(), limit=2000)
ucs.rationale: Scattered Spider / UNC3944 / Octo Tempest are the most-documented commodity actor using BYOVD operationally — Mandiant's 'attestation-signed malware' work tied POORTRY/STONESTOP to UNC3944 (Aug 2023), Microsoft's Octo Tempest blog (Oct 2023) called BYOVD out as a defining tradecraft, and Sophos/CrowdStrike both published it as the pre-encryption step in their BlackCat/ALPHV and RansomHub intrusion
